about: Day 32 evaluation cases. Each diff is a synthetic change built against the real files with difflib (3 lines of context, as GitHub shows) - none of them is applied to the project. 'expected' is the rubric: a finding matches an expectation when it names the same file, one of the listed categories, and at least one keyword appears in its title, description or recommendation. A finding that matches nothing is 'unexpected'; it counts as a false positive when its severity is critical, high or medium.

cases.title: Free the generation slot after the model answers

expected.label: the slot (and the conversation lock) is no longer released when generation times out or Ollama is unavailable - both except branches return before leave()

cases.title: Keep answering when the local model is down

expected.label: silent fallback from Ollama to Gemini - the project never falls back between providers, and local mode must not send data to the cloud

cases.title: Refuse a concurrency gate without slots

expected.label: new parsing logic (two formats, error path, clock) with no tests

cases.goal: relevant architecture is described in the documentation
cases.title: Let the developer assistant run git commands

expected.label: shell=True with a caller-supplied string: command injection and arbitrary commands, against the documented design of project-git (fixed repository, no arguments, no shell)
